56001.text: When do the shortest night and the shortest day occur in the Northern Hemisphere?
options: 21 June shortest night / 21 December shortest day

options: DME operates in the UHF band between 960-1215 MHz.

56021.text: What is the accuracy (margin of error) of the DME system?
options: In general, DME accuracy is calculated as + or – 0.25 NM plus 1.25% of the measured distance.
In general, DME accuracy is calculated as + or – 5 NM plus 25% of the measured distance.

In general, DME accuracy is calculated as + or – 25 km plus 25% of the measured distance.
